items.text: Tampa Bay (Wednesday): Baker Mayfield (thumb) and S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) practiced fully; RT Luke Goedeke (calf), RB Kenny Gainwell (hip) and LB Josiah Trotter (illness) did not practice; WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was limited in a non-contact jersey. Ben Chukwuma starts at RT.

Atlanta (Wednesday): RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring), LB Divine Deablo (forearm) and CB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) did not practice again; OT Jawaan Taylor (hamstring), WR Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) and EDGE Samson Ebukam (hamstring) were limited.
